latest_release.body:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xtekky/gpt4free/compare/v8.9.1...v8.9.2
### Download Options

**Python Package:**
- PyPI: `pip install g4f==v8.9.2`

**Executables (g4f-go, self-contained with embedded Python):**
- Windows amd64: `g4f-go-v8.9.2-windows-amd64.zip`
- Linux x64: `g4f-go-v8.9.2-linux-amd64.zip`
- Linux ARM64: `g4f-go-v8.9.2-linux-arm64.zip`
- macOS x64: `g4f-go-v8.9.2-darwin-amd64.zip`
- macOS ARM64: `g4f-go-v8.9.2-darwin-arm64.zip`
- FreeBSD amd64: `g4f-go-v8.9.2-freebsd-amd64.zip`

**Standalone sandbox launcher (Docker/Podman, image pulled on demand):**
- Windows amd64/arm64: `g4f-sandbox-v8.9.2-windows-<arch>.zip`
- Linux amd64/arm64: `g4f-sandbox-v8.9.2-linux-<arch>.zip`
- macOS amd64/arm64: `g4f-sandbox-v8.9.2-darwin-<arch>.zip`
- Termux/Android arm64: `g4f-sandbox-v8.9.2-android-arm64.zip` (native Python API, no Docker)
- Defaults to the small API-only image (`latest-slim`); `--desktop` pulls the full desktop image only when needed.

**Android App:**
- Android APK: `g4f-v8.9.2.apk`

**Browser Extension (Chrome/Edge):**
- `g4f-browser-extension-v8.9.2.zip` (unzip, then load unpacked via `chrome://extensions`)

**System Packages:**
- WinGet: `winget install gpt4free`

**Docker:**
- `docker pull hlohaus789/g4f:v8.9.2`
- `docker pull hlohaus789/g4f:v8.9.2-slim`
- `docker pull hlohaus789/g4f:v8.9.2-sandbox-desktop`

**Docker sandboxed AI tools sets (one-click install, 100+ different AI tools):**
- `docker pull hlohaus789/g4f:v8.9.2-sandbox-desktop` — a full Xfce desktop (TigerVNC + noVNC) with the g4f API and a one-click menu for 100+ different AI tools: coding agents (OpenCode, Copilot CLI, Hermes, Aider, …), chat UIs, image/audio/video tools and gateways.
- Desktop + API: `http://localhost:8080/desktop/` — API: `http://localhost:8080`
- Mount your own app at `/app/gpt4free` and persist agent settings:
  ```bash
  docker run -d --name g4f-sandbox-desktop \
    -p 8080:8080 -p 5900:5900 --shm-size="2gb" \
    -v ${PWD}:/app/gpt4free \
    -v ${PWD}/sandbox-home/.config:/home/pn/.config \
    -v ${PWD}/sandbox-home/.local:/home/pn/.local \
    hlohaus789/g4f:v8.9.2-sandbox-desktop
  ```
- Docs: [docker/sandbox-menu/README.md](https://github.com/xtekky/gpt4free/blob/main/docker/sandbox-menu/README.md)

--- GPT4Free (g4f) is a community-driven project that aggregates multiple accessible providers and interfaces to make working with modern LLMs and media-generation models easier and more flexible. GPT4Free aims to offer multi-provider support, local GUI, OpenAI-compatible REST APIs, and convenient Python and JavaScript clients — all under a community-first license. This README is a consolidated, improved, and complete guide to installing, running, and contributing to GPT4Free.
